releases.name: Version 1.0.5
releases.body:
- Added Korean translation (thanks Barirn!)
- Added more ambient light to room 1
- Now using NH quantum objects instead of custom implementation (maybe this will lead to QSB compat if I'm not too lazy)
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了韩语翻译（感谢Barirn！）
- 为房间1添加了更多环境光
- 现在使用NH量子物体而不是自定义实现（也许如果我不太懒的话，这将导致QSB兼容）

releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body: Hotfix to fix a shiplog entry that is now inaccurate due to changes from 1.0.3
releases.bodyZh: 热补丁，用于修复由于 1.0.3 版本更新导致的不准确的飞船日志条目

releases.name: Version 1.0.3
releases.body:
Edited a few hints to be more clear to the player
Modified a puzzle's secret solution to be a bit more intuitive
releases.bodyZh:
编辑了一些提示，使其对玩家更清晰  
修改了一个谜题的秘密解决方案，使其稍微更直观

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body:
Wyrm forgot to pull before manually making a release and left out a day worth of work 💀

- Added credits
- Fixed two softlocks
- Stopped ignition sound effect playing when it shouldn't
- Added game over state
- Localized starting popup and item names
- Changed some item names 
- Fixed a global positioning issue for a certain puzzle
- Made a certain puzzle solution more obvious
releases.bodyZh:
Wyrm(维姆)忘记在手动制作发布前拉取代码，遗漏了一天的进度 💀

- 添加了致谢
- 修复了两个软锁
- 停止了在不应播放时播放点火音效
- 添加了游戏结束状态
- 本地化开始弹窗和物品名称
- 更改了一些物品名称
- 修复了一个特定谜题的全局定位问题
- 使某个谜题的解法更明显
